messages.text: I just ordered the Magic M. 40T.  Will it have the Harlo firmware (which is a let better than magicminer firmware) or will it come with magicminer firmware for the Dec 21 shipment?
Searched the web · Magic M. 40T Harlo OS firmware

Hi, I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

Our published spec says it will run Harlo OS. Our Magic M. 40T review says 
it's a 40 TH/s desktop Bitcoin miner in a brushed metal tower, built around 30 BM1370 chips, with the power supply inside the case, Gigabit Ethernet, and Harlo OS on board
, and that 
the 40T ships with Harlo OS built in, with free updates.
 Nothing I've found says Batch 10 is any different. Every 40T is the same hardware.

On the 40T, Harlo OS gives you:
1. **Three modes:** Eco 30 TH/s, Standard 40 TH/s and Turbo 50 TH/s. It ships in Standard. Turbo is an overclock, so it voids the warranty. It also needs good airflow or the unit can overheat and shut down.
2. **Manual tuning:** clock, voltage and fan control beyond the three modes.
3. **Up to four pools at once:** in JD's review he split one unit across three pools, which 
the stock firmware cannot do.


The review was based on a development unit. If you want JD to confirm Harlo OS for Batch 10 specifically, ask in the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and mention @nullhashrate. He builds Harlo OS and answers there.

When your unit arrives, I can help you set up the pool and choose a mode.
You're welcome! Enjoy the 40T. When it arrives, come back to this chat and I'll help you get it hashing.
